channel.title: The Token Dad
channel.description: A dad automating his way out of the overwhelm, and publishing what it costs.

item.title: Seven hero rounds in four days, and the one that shipped
item.description: The site has a design now. This is the record of how it got one: a closed design run, six rejected heroes, eighteen screenshots of sites I liked, three cheap sketches, and a taste pass I ran against my own work.

item.title: Why I'm building this in public
item.description: I forget things. I got tired of apologizing for it, so I started handing the remembering to machines, and publishing every peso it costs.
